pages.text: Right-click a cell with an empty hand.$(br2)The bar across the top is the charge, and under it are the real numbers, which matters above tier 6: past that a cell holds more than the energy capability can report, so the number on screen is the only honest one.

pages.title: The two slots
pages.text: Beside the bar are two slots.$(br2)The $(o)left$() one is charged $(o)from$() the cell: drop a drill or a battery in and it fills.$(br2)The $(o)right$() one is drained $(o)into$() the cell: drop a full battery in and the cell takes its power.

pages.title: Side configuration
pages.text: The six squares in the middle are the cell unfolded: top above, the four sides across, bottom below.$(br2)Click one to step that face through $(6)disabled$(), $(a)input only$(), $(c)output only$() and $(b)both$(). The colour is the setting; the letter only says which face it is.$(br2)Faces default to both.
